title: Website Monitoring - 48 Sites
description: Read top to bottom: how many are down, why, then timing and certificates. Visual theme: Sunset Orange.

panels.title: SSL Expiring
panels.description: Certificates with fewer than 14 days left.

options.content: Status is **UP**, **DOWN**, or **SLOW**. **What happened** says Unavailable, Forbidden, Unauthorized, or No HTTP response. **SSL** says OK, Expiring, Critical, or No certificate. A page that only says the route is missing is still UP.

panels.title: SSL certificates
panels.description: OK, Expiring, Critical, or No certificate, with the certificate date.
